looking_for.en: Backend or platform engineering roles on product teams that own domain-heavy systems end to end — .NET Core or Golang, distributed services on Kubernetes. Open to remote or Taiwan-based.
looking_for.zh: 尋找由團隊端到端負責領域系統的後端／平台工程職位 — .NET Core 或 Golang、Kubernetes 上的分散式服務。可接受遠端或台灣在地。

summary.en: Backend and platform engineer with 4 years building microservices and domain-heavy systems across fintech and enterprise. Ships production .NET Core services with Clean Architecture, CQRS, and TDD, and runs them on Kubernetes (CKAD-certified) across Azure and Oracle Cloud. Led a credit-loan monolith into 10+ microservices and replaced a heavyweight spec process with a lighter workflow the team adopted across 3–4 projects. Writes Golang and ships open source outside work — 80+ articles across long-form technical series at Coding Afternoon (6.4K monthly unique visitors). Alongside the backend track runs a blockchain and applied-cryptography one: a master's thesis on a Chameleon Hash based encryption scheme, an ECC cryptography SDK on NuGet with 2.7K downloads, a 30-day series building a redactable blockchain from scratch, and a risk-ranking API for on-chain perpetual-futures traders.
summary.zh: 4 年微服務與領域系統開發經驗的後端／平台工程師，橫跨金融科技與企業領域。以 Clean Architecture、CQRS 與 TDD 交付生產環境的 .NET Core 服務，並在 Azure 與 Oracle Cloud 的 Kubernetes 上營運（持有 CKAD 認證）。主導信用貸款單體系統拆分為 10 個以上微服務，並以自製的輕量流程取代過重的規格流程，獲團隊採用於 3 至 4 個專案。工作之外以 Golang 寫作與開源 — Coding Afternoon 累積 80 篇以上長篇技術系列文章（月不重複訪客 6.4K）。後端主線之外另有一條區塊鏈與應用密碼學的脈絡：碩士論文為基於 Chameleon Hash 的加密方案、發布於 NuGet 且累計下載 2.7K 的 ECC 密碼學 SDK、30 天從零打造可修改區塊鏈的系列，以及一套鏈上永續合約交易員的風險排行 API。

details.en: Built the .NET Core backends powering a global vehicle-care platform's Taiwan-market expansion, with Clean Architecture, CQRS, and TDD.
details.zh: 建置支撐全球車輛護理平台台灣市場擴張的 .NET Core 後端，採用 Clean Architecture、CQRS 與 TDD。

achievements.en: Built the CRM Client-360 platform end to end: six domains as MediatR vertical slices, multi-tenant isolated; now in pre-launch trial
achievements.zh: 端到端建置 CRM 客戶 360 平台：六個領域以 MediatR 垂直切片實作、多租戶隔離，目前上線前試營運

achievements.en: Owned Taiwan's main customer channel end to end on the LINE Messaging API: HMAC-verified webhooks, account binding, Flex messaging, Hangfire notifications
achievements.zh: 端到端負責台灣主要客戶管道的 LINE Messaging API 整合：HMAC webhook 驗證、帳號綁定、Flex 訊息、Hangfire 排程通知

achievements.en: Eliminated duplicate charges at concurrent checkout with an atomic transaction state machine; shipped e-invoicing (issue / void / allowance) with rollback
achievements.zh: 以原子條件更新的交易狀態機消除併發結帳的重複扣款，並交付電子發票開立／作廢／折讓，含失敗回滾

achievements.en: Made one codebase serve two markets with country-dispatched ID validators (Spanish DNI/NIE, Taiwan ID) and country-scoped document catalogs
achievements.zh: 以依國別分派的證件驗證器（西班牙 DNI/NIE、台灣身分證與統一編號）與國別範圍的證件目錄，讓單一程式碼庫服務兩個市場

achievements.en: Built the platform's cross-cutting layer: EF Core interceptors for field-level audit logging, plus role and module-level access control

details.zh: 將信用貸款平台遷移至微服務，建置其 Oracle Cloud 基礎設施，並為團隊導入規格驅動開發。

details.zh: 支付處理與第三方 API 整合，以 TDD 與六邊形架構開發。
